Sign catalogue

Sign

M389

Looks like: leaf shape with a branched mark rising from the bottom

Open Indus description, written from the drawing. This describes the picture, not the meaning: a sign that looks like a fish may stand for a sound or another word.

Medial

Appears in 82 texts (134 uses), mostly on seals at Mohenjo-daro; found at the start, middle and end of texts.

Where it appears 82

Counts are distinct texts in the Mahadevan 1977 concordance (a text repeated on many moulded tablets counts once). 132 objects in all carry it.
